text: Hey, does anyone know how we’re actually measuring the impact of the People Analytics Office Hours? I need to put something in my quarterly report.

Yeah, Sam, it’s in the handbook somewhere but basically we look at a few things—like, if people are sending fewer questions through email or Slack, that’s one. Also, there’s a Tableau dashboard that tracks usage, and I think follow-up project requests from office hours get tagged in the tracker with something like PA-office-hours. Let me know if you need the links.
That helps, thanks Chloe! I’ll check the handbook for the details and grab the dashboard link. If anyone has the tracker handy, drop it here?
